AIIMS Issues Guidelines on Social Media Use of Name and Logo

The All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS) has issued new guidelines regarding the use of its name and logo on social media platforms. These guidelines ban the unauthorized use of the institute's name and logo. Written approval from the concerned departments is now required for such usage. The move aims to regulate how the institution is represented online.
